entities.name: Drix
entities.description: A gray-skinned humanoid species of the Edge that weftwalks and hunts Eldrazi potentiates.

entities.name: Pinnacle
entities.description: An alliance that traded with the Drix for FTL secrets.

entities.name: Fomori
entities.description: A people who fought the Eldrazi alongside the Drix and then disappeared from the Edge.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Entities the Drix hunt to prevent their return.

entities.name: Fabric of All Being
entities.description: An ancient artifact holding the fates of all things, used by the Drix to unlock weftwalking.

entities.name: Chaos Wall
entities.description: Barrier beyond which the Multiverse and Blind Eternities lie.

entities.name: Weft
entities.description: The Blind Eternities behind the Chaos Wall accessed by weftwalking.

entities.name: Fomori-Eldrazi war
entities.description: War in which the Fomori and Drix fought an Eldrazi incursion.

events.summary: During the Fomori-Eldrazi war the Fomori and Drix fight an Eldrazi incursion; the Eldrazi go into remission and the Fomori vanish.
events.quote: the Fomori and the Drix fought an incursion of the Eldrazi through the Chaos Wall

events.summary: The Drix meet a nascent Pinnacle and exchange FTL secrets for authority over ejecta from the Chaos Wall.
events.quote: In exchange for the secrets of FTL travel

events.summary: Pinnacle promises to visit whenever a star is about to die and to help the Drix search the dying system.
events.quote: The Drix also received a promise from Pinnacle .

relations.quote: The Drix also received a promise from Pinnacle .
the Drix have remained consummate Eldrazi hunters
